Pot & Reveal — billiards picture-reveal game

How to play

  1. Choose a mystery picture from the wall.
  2. Tap the card to flip it, then press Play.
  3. Pot balls in the billiards game to progressively reveal the photograph.
  4. Complete the picture to keep it in your collection.

FAQ

What is Pot & Reveal?

A free online billiards game where photographs are progressively uncovered as you play.

How are pictures revealed?

Each successful pot reveals another section of the hidden photograph. The more you pot, the more of the image you see.

Do I need to download anything?

No. The game runs directly in the web browser on desktop or mobile.

Can I share a reveal?

Yes. Flip a completed card to copy its replay link — sharing is for that individual reveal, not the whole collection.

Is there a right order to play the pictures?

No. Pick any mystery card you like. The wall keeps a fixed order; solved pictures stay in place and the rest remain mysteries until you solve them.

Play

  • Nine ball make a break and share replay link with friends
  • Three cushion billiards the ultimate test of physics and player (average on both counts). You need the beginner mode.
  • Sagu Korean four-ball carom game.
  • Snooker we await the first 147.
  • 8-Ball try it in Hi-Res mode!
  • Play vs the Claw and TheFarJaw.
  • Multiplayer online pool lobby.

Features

  • Backspin, sidespin and cushion bounces well modeled.
  • Record and playback breaks.
  • Two player online mode with nchan nginx server.
  • Nine ball, snooker, three cushion and Sagu billiards rules.
  • Presentation using WebGL in any modern browser on mobile, linux, mac or windows.
